section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the present study, which investigated the associations between multiple facets of positive body image and hedonic and eudaimonic well-being. It highlights that body appreciation was the strongest predictor of well-being and discusses the consistency of these findings with previous research, while also noting the study's unique contribution in linking positive body image to psychological and social well-being. The section also addresses correlations with BMI and age, conceptual overlap between body image variables, and limitations such as the cross-sectional design, reliance on an online sample, and recruitment bias towards women.
